assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: social sharing OGP cover, wide landscape approximately 1200:630 ratio. Create a polished Japanese website social sharing graphic for みどり♻リサイクル. Reference image 1 is the paper-craft neighborhood and recycled-item illustration style; reference image 2 is the brand symbol. Recompose those assets into an elegant professional cover. Warm ivory background, forest green typography, spacious clean editorial layout. At upper left use the green leaf symbol and EXACT Japanese brand text 'みどり♻リサイクル'. Main headline very large in the upper and middle part: '悩んだら、' on line 1 and 'まずお電話ください！' on line 2. Smaller subtitle '不用品の回収・買取相談' and small tag '関東エリア対応'. Keep all Japanese text impeccably spelled and readable with bold Japanese sans serif. Paper-craft scene along bottom quarter only, do not cover the title. No other text, no phone numbers, no badges, no additional claims. Output finished single cover image, not a mockup.
